title: Introducing Binance Spot Copy Trading Features
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to introduce  five Spot Copy Trading features , designed to provide users with additional tools for automation, comparison, transparency, and risk-free simulation. These updates are now live for all eligible users. Overview of Spot Copy Trading Features  1. Auto-Invest for Spot Copy Trading Users can now schedule recurring copy trades by configuring: Investment amount Trade frequency Stop-loss percentage Once set, portfolios will automatically follow the selected Lead Trader’s actions based on these parameters. 2. Lead Trader Comparison Tool A new comparison interface allows users to view and assess multiple Lead Traders side-by-side based on metrics such as: Return on Investment (ROI) and win rate Profit-sharing ratios Number of copiers Top traded tokens Total Profit and Loss (PnL) This tool is designed to support data-informed selection of Lead Traders. 3. Mock Spot Copy Trading Users can now simulate Spot copy trading with virtual funds to test strategies without financial risk. To participate: Go to  [Trade]  >  [Copy Trading] Choose a portfolio and select  [Mock Copy] Monitor it under  [Spot Overview]  >  [Mock Copy Trading] Convert to live trading anytime with one click. Users can mock up to 10 portfolios simultaneously. Promotion incentive : If any mock portfolio reaches  +5% PnL  during the Promotion Period, users will receive  1 USDC . Please refer to the “Spot Copy Trading Campaign” section below for more information. Note : All mock data is deleted upon ending the simulation. 4. Spot Failed Orders Tab A new tab within copy portfolios now displays failed trade orders. This feature aims to improve transparency by allowing users to review incomplete or unsuccessful trades alongside active and closed positions. 5. Private Portfolios for Lead Traders Lead Traders can now set portfolios to "invite-only," limiting follower access. This feature is intended to support private strategy sharing or premium group offerings. Spot Copy Trading Campaign Promotion Period: 2025-04-10 04:00 (UTC) to 2025-05-08 23:59 (UTC) Users who engage with Spot Copy Trading during the Promotion Period may qualify for a chance to share from  20,000 USDC in rewards . For more information on the campaign, please refer to  this announcement .  Start Spot Copy Trading Now Further Information Learn more about how to participate in Spot Copy Trading with these new features in our  blog . Note : There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-04-25
